name: Aadhaar Enrolment & Update
description: 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI to residents of India, based on demographic and biometric data. Used as proof of identity and address and as a KYC token across government and private services.
eligibility: Any resident of India (including infants) irrespective of citizenship status of parents for enrolment; updates available to existing holders.
benefits: Single portable ID accepted nationwide; enables DBT, subsidy linkage, KYC, and access to many government schemes.
optional_documents: Introducer / Head of Family based enrolment where documents unavailable
application_mode: Offline (Enrolment Centre) and Online update (SSUP / mAadhaar)
application_steps: Locate nearest Aadhaar enrolment centre / Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
Fill enrolment/update form and submit supporting documents.
Collect acknowledgement slip with Enrolment ID (EID).
Download e-Aadhaar once UID is generated (verify on uidai.gov.in).
processing_time: Enrolment: up to 90 days for UID generation (typically sooner). Update: up to 30 days.
fees: Enrolment: free. Demographic update: free. Biometric update: Rs. 100 (inclusive of GST) as per UIDAI fee schedule.
validity: Lifelong (subject to deactivation for residents who acquire foreign citizenship).
office_locator_info: Aadhaar Seva Kendra locator at https://bhuvan.uidai.gov.in/locator

faq.q: Is Aadhaar mandatory for all schemes?
faq.a: Aadhaar is required for subsidies/benefits under Section 7 schemes; alternative ID is permitted where Aadhaar not yet assigned.
Use the TOTP-based lock feature on myAadhaar portal or mAadhaar app.

languages_available: Hindi, English and 21 scheduled languages on portal/app
ai_summary: Aadhaar is India's 12-digit resident identity number issued by UIDAI, used for KYC and government benefit delivery.
ai_explanation: Aadhaar links a resident's identity to demographic and biometric data. It is the foundational ID for Direct Benefit Transfer, opening bank accounts, filing taxes, and availing schemes. Enrolment is free; updates may carry a fee. It is not proof of citizenship.

name: Passport Issuance (Passport Seva)
description: Issuance/renewal of Indian passports (ordinary, Tatkaal, diplomatic/official) by the Ministry of External Affairs through Passport Seva Kendras (PSK) and Post Office PSKs.
eligibility: Indian citizen; must provide proof of date of birth, address, and nationality. Minors require parent consent.
benefits: Internationally recognised travel document; enables visa-free/visa-on-arrival access; Tatkaal for urgent issue.
required_documents: Proof of nationality / old passport (if renewing)
application_mode: Online application + in-person appointment at PSK
application_steps: Register on passportindia.gov.in and fill the application form.
Pay fee and book appointment at nearest PSK/PopSK.
Visit PSK with originals + photocopies for document verification and biometric capture.
Police verification (for fresh passports) at registered address.
Passport printed and dispatched; track status online.
processing_time: Tatkaal: ~1-3 days post verification. Normal: ~30 days (post police verification).
fees: Normal 36-page: Rs. 1500. Tatkaal 36-page: Rs. 3500. (10-year validity for adults; minors 5 years / till age 18).
validity: 10 years for adults; 5 years or till age 18 for minors.

faq.q: Can I apply from a different state than my address?
faq.a: You must apply from your current address jurisdiction; police verification happens at the address given.

faq.q: What is the difference between Normal and Tatkaal?
faq.a: Tatkaal is an expedited service with higher fees and pre-verification; Normal follows standard police verification.

ai_summary: Passport Seva issues Indian passports online with in-person verification at PSKs; Normal ~30 days, Tatkaal expedited.
ai_explanation: Citizens apply online, pay a fee, and attend a PSK appointment for document checks and biometrics. Police verification follows for fresh passports. Tatkaal offers faster issue at higher cost. Passports are valid 10 years for adults.
